title: Manthara's sinful words
introduction: Manthara with her wicked thoughts tries to convince Kaikeyi of the possible misfortune that could occur to Kaikeyi and her family if Sri Rama becomes the King. Although Kaikeyi's initial reaction is to praise Rama's qualities; her mind is slowly but surely poisoned by Manathara's sinful words.
closing: || इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्यकाण्डे अष्ठमः सर्गः ||
Thus completes 8th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
मन्थरा त्वभ्यसूयैनामुत्सृज्याभरणं च तत्|
उवाचेदं ततो वाक्यं कोपदुःखसमन्विता
verses.iast:
mantharā tvabhyasūyaināmutsṛjyābharaṇaṃ ca tat |
uvācedaṃ tato vākyaṃ kopaduḥkhasamanvitā
verses.translation: Manthara, becoming indignant with Kaikeyi, threw down the ornament given to her and with anger and distress spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
हर्षं किमिदमस्थाने कृतवत्यसि बालिशे |
शोकसागरमध्यस्थमात्मानं नावबुध्यसे
verses.iast:
harśhaṃ kimidamasthāne kṛtavatyasi bāliśe |
śokasāgaramadhyasthamātmānaṃ nāvabudhyase
verses.translation: "O, foolish one! Not knowing that you are in the midst of an ocean of trouble, what is it that you are so delighted about, in a matter to be grieved?"

glosses.meaning: who are in the midst of an ocean of trouble

verses.devanagari:
मनसा प्रहसामि त्वां देवि दुःखार्धिता सती |
यच्छोचितव्ये हृष्टासि प्राप्येदं व्यसनं महत्
verses.iast:
manasā prahasāmi tvāṃ devi duḥkhārdhitā satī |
yacchocitavye hṛśhṭāsi prāpyedaṃ vyasanaṃ mahat
verses.translation: "Oh, queen! Though stricken with grief, I mentally laugh at you in that you are rejoicing at the time when a great calamity is befalling you."

verses.devanagari:
शोचामि दुर्मतित्वं ते का हि प्राज्ञा प्रहर्षयेत् |
अरेः सपत्नीपुत्रस्य वृद्धिं मृत्युमिवागताम्
verses.iast:
śocāmi durmatitvaṃ te kā hi prājJṇā praharśhayet |
areḥ sapatnīputrasya vṛddhiṃ mṛtyumivāgatām
verses.translation: "I am lamenting over your foolish mind. Does any intelligent woman feel happy over the prosperity of a stepson who is considered an enemy? Does it not amount to praising a befalling death?"

verses.devanagari:
भरतादेव रामस्य राज्यसाधारणाद्भयम् |
तद्विचिन्त्य विषण्णास्मि भय भीताद्धि जायते
verses.iast:
bharatādeva rāmasya rājyasādhāraṇādbhayam |
tadvicintya viśhaṇṇāsmi bhaya bhītāddhi jāyate
verses.translation: "Rama has a fear about Bharata because Bharata has equal rights over the kingdom. In thinking about this matter, I am getting anguished. Do we not get disasters from those who are afraid of us?"

glosses.meaning: who has equal right to kingdom

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणो हि महेष्वासो रामं सर्वात्मना गतः |
शत्रुघ्नश्चापि भरतं काकुत्थ्सं लक्ष्मणो यथा
verses.iast:
lakśmaṇo hi maheśhvāso rāmaṃ sarvātmanā gataḥ |
śatrughnaścāpi bharataṃ kākutthsaṃ lakśmaṇo yathā
verses.translation: "Lakshmana, wielding a great bow, joined Rama with all his heart. Shatrughna is as faithful to Bharata as Lakshmana to Rama".

verses.devanagari:
प्रत्यासन्नक्रमेणापि भरतस्तैव भामिनि |
राज्यक्रमो विप्रकृष्टस्तयोस्तावत्कनीयसोः
verses.iast:
pratyāsannakrameṇāpi bharatastaiva bhāmini |
rājyakramo viprakṛśhṭastayostāvatkanīyasoḥ
verses.translation: "Oh Kaikeyi! In line with even the proximity of birth; the claim to the throne of Bharata alone can be pressed, that of Lakshmana and Satrughna who are younger is out of question."

glosses.meaning: In line with proximity of birth
to the extent of other two(Lakshmana and Satrughna)

verses.devanagari:
विदुषः क्षत्रचारित्रे प्राज्ञस्य प्राप्तकारिणः |
भयात्प्रवेपे रामस्य चिन्तयन्ती तवात्मजम्
verses.iast:
viduśhaḥ kśatracāritre prājJṇasya prāptakāriṇaḥ |
bhayātpravepe rāmasya cintayantī tavātmajam
verses.translation: "Rama is a learned man and a political statesman. His actions are timely and appropriate. When thinking of your son's calamity to be resulted from Rama, I get shaken with fear".

glosses.meaning: he who acts appropriately and in time

verses.devanagari:
सुभगा खलु कौसल्या यस्याः पुत्रोऽभिषेक्ष्यते |
यौवराज्येन महता श्वः पुष्येण द्विजोत्तमैः
verses.iast:
subhagā khalu kausalyā yasyāḥ putro'bhiśhekśyate |
yauvarājyena mahatā śvaḥ puśhyeṇa dvijottamaiḥ
verses.translation: "Kausalya is very fortunate. Brahmans are going to anoint her son for the great princely kingdom tomorrow on the day of Pushyami star".

glosses.meaning: on the day of Pushyami star

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्तां सुमहतीं प्रीतिं प्रतीतां तां हतद्विषम् |
उपस्थास्यसि कौसल्यां दासीवत्त्वं कृताञ्जलिः
verses.iast:
prāptāṃ sumahatīṃ prītiṃ pratītāṃ tāṃ hatadviśham |
upasthāsyasi kausalyāṃ dāsīvattvaṃ kṛtāJṇjaliḥ
verses.translation: "With folded arms, as a maid-servant, you have to serve that Kausalya who having reached great prosperity, in the height of joy, will dispose of her adversaries (in the person of Bharata and yourself)".

verses.devanagari:
एवम् चेत्त्वं सहास्माभिस्तस्याः प्रेष्य भविष्यसि |
पुत्रश्च तव रामस्य प्रेष्यभावं गमिष्यति
verses.iast:
evam cettvaṃ sahāsmābhistasyāḥ preśhya bhaviśhyasi |
putraśca tava rāmasya preśhyabhāvaṃ gamiśhyati
verses.translation: "Thus, if you become Kausalya's servant-maid along with us, your son Bharata will be Rama's attendant."

verses.devanagari:
हृष्टाः खलु भविष्यन्ति रामस्य परमाः स्त्रियः |
अप्रहृष्टा भविष्यन्ति स्नुषास्ते भरतक्षये
verses.iast:
hṛśhṭāḥ khalu bhaviśhyanti rāmasya paramāḥ striyaḥ |
aprahṛśhṭā bhaviśhyanti snuśhāste bharatakśaye
verses.translation: "Rama's wives will get delighted. Your daughters-in-law will be unhappy because of Bharata's waning position."
notes: Comment: The words 'Rama's wives' here do not indicate that Rama had multiple wives. Manathara refers to a possible future where Rama being a King would marry other women. It was a norm then for a king to have more than one wife.

verses.devanagari:
तां दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतां ब्रुवन्तीं मन्थरां ततः |
रामस्यैव गुणान् देवी कैकेयि प्रशशंस ह
verses.iast:
tāṃ dṛśhṭvā paramaprītāṃ bruvantīṃ mantharāṃ tataḥ |
rāmasyaiva guṇān devī kaikeyi praśaśaṃsa ha
verses.translation: Hearing Manthara speak thus in many distasteful words, Kaikeyi began to extol Rama's virtues, saying: -

verses.devanagari:
धर्मज्ञो गुरुभिर्दान्तः कृतज्ञ सत्यवाक्चुचि |
रामो राज्ञः सुतो ज्येष्ठो यौवराज्यमतोऽर्हति
verses.iast:
dharmajJṇo gurubhirdāntaḥ kṛtajJṇa satyavākcuci |
rāmo rājJṇḥ suto jyeśhṭho yauvarājyamato'rhati
verses.translation: "Rama knows all righteousness. Elders trained him. He has a proper gratitude. He speaks truth. He has a clean conduct. He is the eldest son of king Dasaratha and hence eligible for the kingdom."

verses.devanagari:
भ्रात्ऱ्^ऊन्भृत्यांश्च दीर्घायुः पितृवत्पालयिष्यति |
संतप्यसे कथं कुब्जे श्रुत्वा रामाभिषेचनम्
verses.iast:
bhrātR^ūnbhṛtyāṃśca dīrghāyuḥ pitṛvatpālayiśhyati |
santapyase kathaṃ kubje śrutvā rāmābhiśhecanam
verses.translation: "The long living Rama will protect his brothers and servants like a father. O, the hunch backed one! Why are you so pained on hearing about Rama's coronation?"

verses.devanagari:
भरतश्चापि रामस्य ध्रुवं वर्षशतात्परम् |
पितृपैतामहं राज्यमवाप्ता पुरुषर्षभः
verses.iast:
bharataścāpi rāmasya dhruvaṃ varśhaśatātparam |
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyamavāptā puruśharśhabhaḥ
verses.translation: "After Rama's rule for one hundred years, Bharata the best among men will certainly replace Rama on his father's throne, which is that of his ancestors."

glosses.meaning: which belongs to (his) father and forefathers.

verses.devanagari:
सा त्वमभ्युदये प्राप्ते वर्तमाने च मन्थरे |
भविष्यति च कल्याणे किमर्थं परितप्यसे
verses.iast:
sā tvamabhyudaye prāpte vartamāne ca manthare |
bhaviśhyati ca kalyāṇe kimarthaṃ paritapyase
verses.translation: "Oh, Manthara! When we got an occasion for rejoicing as at present and when a festive occasion is to come off in future (too in the form of Bharata's installation, no matter even if it comes after a hundred years), why do you feel agonized like this as though burning (with jealousy)?"

glosses.meaning: is to come off in future (too in the form of Bharata's installation
feel agonized like this as though burning (with jealousy)?

verses.devanagari:
यथा ने भरतो मान्यस्तथा भूयोऽपि राघावः |
कौसल्यातोऽरिक्तं च सो हि शुश्रूषते हि माम्
verses.iast:
yathā ne bharato mānyastathā bhūyo'pi rāghāvaḥ |
kausalyāto'riktaṃ ca so hi śuśrūśhate hi mām
verses.translation: "For me, Rama is as lovable as Bharata and even more. Is he not doing more service to me than to Kausalya?"

verses.devanagari:
राज्यं यदि हि रामस्य भरतस्यापि तत्तदा |
मन्यते हि यथात्मानं तथा भ्रात्ऱ्^ऊंश्च राघवः
verses.iast:
rājyaṃ yadi hi rāmasya bharatasyāpi tattadā |
manyate hi yathātmānaṃ tathā bhrātR^ūṃśca rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "If Rama has kingdom then Bharata has it as well. Rama esteems his brothers just as his own self."

verses.devanagari:
कैकेयीवचनं श्रुत्वा मन्थरा भृशदुःखिता |
दीर्घमुष्णं निःश्वस्य कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
kaikeyīvacanaṃ śrutvā mantharā bhṛśaduḥkhitā |
dīrghamuśhṇaṃ niḥśvasya kaikeyīmidamabravīt
verses.translation: Manthara, after hearing Kaikeyi's words, felt very sad and after a long and hot sigh, spoke to her the following words:

verses.devanagari:
अनर्थदर्शिनी मौर्ख्यान्नात्मानमवबुध्यसे |
शोकव्यसनविस्तीर्णे मज्जन्ती दुःखसागरे
verses.iast:
anarthadarśinī maurkhyānnātmānamavabudhyase |
śokavyasanavistīrṇe majjantī duḥkhasāgare
verses.translation: "On one side, you are getting immersed in an ocean of sorrow filled with misery and danger. But due to stupidity, you are not able to perceive the truth and you fail to assess your real position."

verses.devanagari:
भविता राघवो राजा राघवस्यानु यः सुतः |
राजवंशात्तु कैकेयि भरतः परिहास्यते
verses.iast:
bhavitā rāghavo rājā rāghavasyānu yaḥ sutaḥ |
rājavaṃśāttu kaikeyi bharataḥ parihāsyate
verses.translation: "O,Kaikeyi! If Rama becomes the king, his son will become the king after him in succession. Thus, Bharata's name itself will be removed from the royal clan."

glosses.meaning: the son is (he becomes the king)

verses.devanagari:
न हि राज्ञः सुताः सर्वे राज्ये तिष्ठन्ति भामिनि |
स्थाप्यमानेषु सर्वेषु सुमहाननयो भवेत्
verses.iast:
na hi rājJṇaḥ sutāḥ sarve rājye tiśhṭhanti bhāmini |
sthāpyamāneśhu sarveśhu sumahānanayo bhavet
verses.translation: "O, Kaikeyi! All the sons of a king will not be crowned for a kingdom. If all are installed, there will be a great lawlessness."

verses.devanagari:
तस्माज्ज्येष्ठे हि कैकेयि राज्यतन्त्राणि पार्थिवाः |
स्थापयन्त्यनवद्याङ्गि गुणवत्स्वतरेष्वपि
verses.iast:
tasmājjyeśhṭhe hi kaikeyi rājyatantrāṇi pārthivāḥ |
sthāpayantyanavadyāṇ^gi guṇavatsvatareśhvapi
verses.translation: "Therefore, kings, O, Kaikeyi of faultless limbs, install their eldest son, eventhough others may be full of virtues, as their successor to the throne."

verses.devanagari:
असावत्यन्तनिर्भग्न स्तवपुत्रो भविष्यति |
अनाथवत्सुखेभ्यश्च राजवंशाच्च वत्सले
verses.iast:
asāvatyantanirbhagna stavaputro bhaviśhyati |
anāthavatsukhebhyaśca rājavaṃśācca vatsale
verses.translation: "Oh, Kaikeyi the affectionate one! Your son will be completely distant from comforts and even from the royal clan; like an orphan."

verses.devanagari:
साहं त्वदर्थे संप्राप्ता त्वं तु मां नावबुध्यसे |
सपत्निवृद्दौ या मे त्वं प्रदेयं दातुमिच्चिसि
verses.iast:
sāhaṃ tvadarthe samprāptā tvaṃ tu māṃ nāvabudhyase |
sapatnivṛddau yā me tvaṃ pradeyaṃ dātumiccisi
verses.translation: "I came here in your interests. But you have not understood me. You think it fit to give me a present when your step-wife is getting prospered."

glosses.meaning: when there is prosperity for step-wife.

verses.devanagari:
ध्रुवं तु भरतं रामः प्राप्य राज्यमकण्टकम् |
देशान्तरं वासयिता लोकान्तरमथापि व
verses.iast:
dhruvaṃ tu bharataṃ rāmaḥ prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam |
deśāntaraṃ vāsayitā lokāntaramathāpi va
verses.translation: "Rama, ascending the throne without hindrance, will either send away Bharata to some other country or have him put to death. This is certain."

verses.devanagari:
बाल एव हि मातुल्यं भरतो नायितस्त्वया |
सन्निकर्षाच्च सौहार्दं जायते स्थावरेष्वपि
verses.iast:
bāla eva hi mātulyaṃ bharato nāyitastvayā |
sannikarśhācca sauhārdaṃ jāyate sthāvareśhvapi
verses.translation: "You sent Bharata to his maternal uncle's house even in his childhood. By being nearer, love is born even on inanimate objects. By sending Bharata to a distant place, you made Dasaratha to have no affection towards him."

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्यानुवशगः शत्रुघ्नोऽपि समं गतः |
लक्ष्मणो हि यथा रामं तथासौ भरतं गतः
verses.iast:
bharatasyānuvaśagaḥ śatrughno'pi samaṃ gataḥ |
lakśmaṇo hi yathā rāmaṃ tathāsau bharataṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: "Shatrughna was drawn towards Bharata and went along with him. Just as Lakshmana joined Rama, Shatrughna joined Bharata."
notes: Comment: Sage Valmiki might be implying here that if Shatrughna were to be present then at Ayodhya, he would have tried for the prosperity of Bharata.

verses.devanagari:
श्रूयते हि द्रुमः कश्चिच्चेत्तव्यो वनजीविभिः |
सन्निकर्षादिषीकाभिर्मो चितः परमाद्भयात्
verses.iast:
śrūyate hi drumaḥ kaściccettavyo vanajīvibhiḥ |
sannikarśhādiśhīkābhirmo citaḥ paramādbhayāt
verses.translation: "We hear that a tree marked down for felling by foresters, when covered by thorny Ishhiika grass, is saved from this great danger of cutting. So also, Dasaratha might have supported Bharata if he was staying near to him in Ayodhya."

verses.devanagari:
गोप्ता हि रामं सौमित्रिर्लक्ष्मणं चापि राघवः |
अश्विनोरिव सौभ्रात्रं तयोर्लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.iast:
goptā hi rāmaṃ saumitrirlakśmaṇaṃ cāpi rāghavaḥ |
aśvinoriva saubhrātraṃ tayorlokeśhu viśrutam
verses.translation: "Lakshmana protects Rama. Rama protects Lakshmana. Their brotherly love is as famous as that of Aswini celestials."

verses.devanagari:
तस्मान्न लक्ष्मणे रामः पापं किञ्चित्करिष्यति |
रामस्तु भरते पापं कुर्यादिति न संशयः
verses.iast:
tasmānna lakśmaṇe rāmaḥ pāpaṃ kiJṇcitkariśhyati |
rāmastu bharate pāpaṃ kuryāditi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: "Hence, Rama will not do a sinful act of killing Lakshmana. However there is no doubt that he will do so in the case of Bharata."

verses.devanagari:
तस्माद्राजगृहादेव वनं गच्छतु ते सुतः |
एतद्धि रोचते मह्यं भृश्ं चापि हितं तव
verses.iast:
tasmādrājagṛhādeva vanaṃ gacchatu te sutaḥ |
etaddhi rocate mahyaṃ bhṛśṃ cāpi hitaṃ tava
verses.translation: "Hence, I feel that it is better for your son to go to forest directly from his uncle's house. This is good for you too."

glosses.meaning: from royal palace (of his uncle) itself

verses.devanagari:
एवं ते ज्ञातिपक्षस्य श्रेयश्चैव भविष्यति |
यदि चेद्भरतो धर्मात्पित्र्यं राज्यमवाप्स्यति
verses.iast:
evaṃ te jJṇātipakśasya śreyaścaiva bhaviśhyati |
yadi cedbharato dharmātpitryaṃ rājyamavāpsyati
verses.translation: "If Bharata gets his father's kingdom as per law, it will be beneficial to you and your side of relatives."

glosses.meaning: and to your side of relatives

verses.devanagari:
स ते सुखोचितो बालो रामस्य सहजो रिपुः |
समृद्धार्थस्य नष्टार्थो जीविष्यति कथं वशे
verses.iast:
sa te sukhocito bālo rāmasya sahajo ripuḥ |
samṛddhārthasya naśhṭārtho jīviśhyati kathaṃ vaśe
verses.translation: "Your youthful son, habituated to comforts, is a natural enemy to Rama. How can Bharata who failed to achieve his purpose live under control of Rama; whose flourishing object has been realised?"

glosses.meaning: of Rama whose flourishing object has been realized?

verses.devanagari:
अभिद्रुतमिवारण्ये सिंहेन गजयूथपम् |
प्रच्छाद्यमानं रामेण भरतं त्रातुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
abhidrutamivāraṇye siṃhena gajayūthapam |
pracchādyamānaṃ rāmeṇa bharataṃ trātumarhasi
verses.translation: "Rama is chasing and bringing down Bharata as a lion chases an elephant-king in forest. You ought to protect Bharata."

verses.devanagari:
दर्पान्निराकृता पूर्वं त्वया सौभाग्यवत्तया |
राममाता सपत्नी ते कथं वैरं न शातयेत्
verses.iast:
darpānnirākṛtā pūrvaṃ tvayā saubhāgyavattayā |
rāmamātā sapatnī te kathaṃ vairaṃ na śātayet
verses.translation: "Previously, you treated Kausalya with disrespect due to arrogance that you were fortunate. Will not such Kausalya, your rival wife, revenge for that animosity?"

verses.devanagari:
यदा हि रामः पृथिवीमवाप्स्यति |
प्रभूतरत्नाकरशैलपत्तनाम् |
तदा गमिष्यस्यशुभं पराभवं |
सहैव दीना भरतेन भामिनि
verses.iast:
yadā hi rāmaḥ pṛthivīmavāpsyati |
prabhūtaratnākaraśailapattanām |
tadā gamiśhyasyaśubhaṃ parābhavaṃ |
sahaiva dīnā bharatena bhāmini
verses.translation: "O, Kaikeyi! The day Rama becomes lord of this earth with its great oceans, mountains and towns; that day you and your Bharata will get a bad and pitiable position of ignominy."

verses.devanagari:
यदा हि रामः पृथिवीमवाप्स्यति |
ध्रुवं प्रणष्टो भरतो भविष्यति |
अतो हि संचिन्तय राज्यमात्मजे |
पर्स्य चैवाद्य विवासकारणम्
verses.iast:
yadā hi rāmaḥ pṛthivīmavāpsyati |
dhruvaṃ praṇaśhṭo bharato bhaviśhyati |
ato hi sañcintaya rājyamātmaje |
parsya caivādya vivāsakāraṇam
verses.translation: "When Rama gets power of the kingdom Bharata will certainly get ruined. Hence, think of a solution to get your son Bharata the kingdom and to send Rama, your enemy, to exile."
